meal.title: Wrap the Slot Machine Flow in a main() Function
meal.objective: Encapsulate the entire program flow inside a main function and invoke it.

voice.script: What if you could start your slot game with a single command? How do you organize the program so it runs automatically? First, think of a function as a reusable recipe. Define a function called main to hold the program flow. Inside main we ask for a deposit, get the number of lines, validate the bet per line, generate a random spin, and print a summary. Now we write the main function and invoke it. Finally, remember that putting everything in main keeps the code tidy and runnable. To practice, try adding a welcome message inside main before the deposit step.
